items.title: Gurde ke kaam ka hormonal qaboo (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the hormonal control of kidney function (PDF 17-18).

blocks.text: Jab jism ko pani bachana ho to gurde hypertonic peshab nikalte hain, aur jab pani zyada ho to hypotonic. Do hormones is kaam ko murattab karte hain.

ADH pani bachane ka jism ka sab se aham auzar hai. Yeh hypothalamus banata aur posterior pituitary gland khoon mein chhorta hai. Jab jism mein pani kam ho ya namkeen khana khaya ho to hypothalamus ke osmoreceptors khoon mein namak ki zyada miqdar pakarte hain. Phir hypothalamus pyaas ka ehsas paida karta aur posterior pituitary ko ADH chhorne ka signal deta hai. ADH collecting ducts ki deewaron ko pani ke liye zyada khula (permeable) karta hai, to zyada pani filtrate se namkeen mayi aur phir khoon mein jata hai: gaarha peshab banta aur pani bachta hai.

Jab khoon mein namak kam ho jaye to hypothalamus ADH ka ifraz rok deta hai. Collecting duct ki deewarein kam permeable ho jati hain, kam pani wapas jata aur patla peshab nikalta hai; khoon ka hajm aur blood pressure kam hote hain.

blocks.title: Diabetes insipidus
blocks.text: Jo shakhs pituitary ki kharabi ki wajah se kaafi ADH nahi bana sakta woh musalsal bohat sa patla peshab karta hai. Is bimari ko diabetes insipidus kehte hain; aise shakhs ko shadeed pani ki kami (dehydration) aur bohat kam blood pressure ka khatra hota hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: ADH khoon ka hajm aur is tarah blood pressure barhata hai. Yeh khoon ki nalyon ko sukarta (tang karta) bhi hai, jis se blood pressure aur barhta hai.

Aldosterone peshab mein sodium aur potassium ki miqdar qaboo karta hai. Yeh adrenal cortex banata hai, yaani gurde ke oopar adrenal gland ki bahari teh. Yeh tab nikalta hai jab blood pressure gire ya khoon mein sodium bohat kam ho. Yeh distal convoluted tubule aur collecting duct ki deewaron par asar kar ke filtrate se khoon mein sodium ions ka reabsorption barhata hai; khoon mein sodium barhne se pani bhi filtrate se khoon mein jata hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Aldosterone peshab mein potassium ions ke ikhraj ko bhi barhata hai. Is se hyperkalaemia se bachao hota hai, khoon mein potassium ki khatarnak had tak zyada miqdar jo dil ki dharkan ki be-qaidgi (cardiac arrhythmias) paida kar sakti hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: nephron par number wale qadam: 1 glomerulus se capsule mein zyada dabao par filtration; 2 reabsorption, zyada tar proximal tubule mein, glucose, amino acids, namak aur taqreeban 75% pani ki; 3 distal tubule mein H+, NH4+, K+ aur dawaon ka secretion. Medulla gehrai ke saath zyada namkeen dikhaya gaya; descending limb se pani nikalta, ascending limb se Na+ bahar pump hota, aur collecting duct se pani nikalta hai. blocks.caption: Gurde ka hormonal qaboo: ADH aur aldosterone (hormonal qaboo wale hisse ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Peshab teen qadmon mein banta hai. Filtration: efferent arteriole afferent se tang hai, is liye glomerulus mein dabao zyada rehta aur pani, urea, glucose, amino acids, vitamins aur namak ko Bowman's capsule mein dhakelta hai, plasma ka taqreeban paanchwan hissa, jabke proteins aur cells khoon mein rehte hain. Reabsorption: zyada tar mufeed cheezein proximal tubule mein wapas jati hain; descending limb pani nikalne deti, ascending limb namak bahar pump karti, aur distal tubule aur collecting duct mazeed wapas lete hain. Secretion: distal tubule H+, NH4+, K+ aur dawayein shamil karta hai. Loop se bana namkeen medulla collecting duct se pani kheenchta hai, zyada jab ADH duct ko pani ke liye khula (permeable) kar de; aldosterone distal tubule aur duct se Na+ wapas lene par majboor karta aur pani us ke peeche jata hai.

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Yeh hissa 14.1.2 chhapa hai magar 14.2 ke neeche (14.2.2) hona chahiye. Kitab yeh bhi kehti hai ke hypothalamus posterior pituitary ko 'pyaas ka ehsas paida karne' ka signal deta hai; pyaas hypothalamus ka apna thirst centre paida karta hai, jabke posterior pituitary ADH chhorta hai.

blocks.prompt: Aik shakhs ne bohat namkeen khana khaya. ADH peshab ko kaise badalta hai, qadam ba qadam batayein.
blocks.explanation: Hypothalamus ke osmoreceptors khoon mein zyada namak pakarte hain; pyaas lagti aur posterior pituitary ADH chhorta hai; collecting ducts pani ke liye zyada permeable hoti hain; zyada pani namkeen medulla aur khoon mein jata hai; thora sa gaarha peshab banta hai.

items: ADH (hypothalamus, posterior pituitary): collecting duct zyada permeable, gaarha peshab; is ki kami: diabetes insipidus.
Aldosterone (adrenal cortex): DCT aur duct Na+ wapas lete, pani peeche, K+ nikalta hai.
Glomerular capillaries zyada dabao par filter karti; peritubular capillaries kam dabao par reabsorb aur secrete karti hain.
